title: Thai Sea Bass with Noodles
description: A flavorful and nutritious dish featuring seared sea bass, served with a delicious Thai-inspired noodle sauce. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: rice noodles
ingredients.notes: Soak in hot water for 5 minutes

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.notes: Add flavor to the noodle sauce

instructions: 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
2. In a small pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat. Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
3. Add the coconut milk to the pan and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 5 minutes.
4. Meanwhile, preheat a non-stick skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat. Season the sea bass fillets with salt and pepper.
5. Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the skillet and sear the sea bass for 3-4 minutes per side, until cooked through.
6. To serve, place the cooked noodles on a plate, top with the seared sea bass, and spoon the Thai noodle sauce over the top.
7. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
